findings.issue: No direct P. texensis treatment in 1999 North Central Texas flora
findings.result: Flora of North America includes a named Philadelphus texensis treatment, including varieties; use this alternate treatment for source-backed morphology rather than substituting P. pubescens.

Kew POWO recognizes Philadelphus texensis and P. texensis var. ernestii, treating Philadelphus ernestii as a synonym of var. ernestii. ITIS (Hydrangeaceae update 2011) instead reports P. texensis as a synonym of P. ernestii. Preserve the repository's P. texensis name and the source disagreement; do not automatically merge species or varieties.

findings.issue: Hays-area observation does not prove wild population
findings.result: Purola Preserve records P. texensis as deliberately introduced from a University of Texas rare-plant project; do not treat this as a wild nativity record.

still_needed: Extract morphology directly from FNA P. texensis treatment and attribute any varietal characters to the applicable variety.
If needed, reconcile P. texensis versus P. ernestii using original 2016 taxonomic revision, retaining differing source concepts.
preservation: Additive research record only; species.json, photos, rights, and site unchanged
